Greek.name: Zeus, the Wrath of Thunder
Greek.title: King
Greek.text: The sky splits at his command, reducing armies to ash. To summon him requires a sacrifice worthy of Olympus.

Greek.name: Hera, Queen of Olympus
Greek.title: Queen
Greek.text: Her absolute authority bolsters those who fight in her name. A mere gesture from the Queen inspires unbreakable devotion.

Greek.name: Hades, Underworld Lord
Greek.title: Bishop
Greek.text: The ruler of the dead cannot be truly slain. He rises from the ashes of battle, claiming the fallen for his own.

Greek.name: Poseidon, Master of the Seas
Greek.title: Rook
Greek.text: His trident pierces through enemy lines like a tidal wave. None can stand before the earth-shaker's wrath.

Greek.name: Apollo, the Sun's Chariot
Greek.title: Rook
Greek.text: The master archer strikes from afar, ignoring earthly barricades. His golden arrows never miss their mark.

Greek.name: Athena, the Embodiment of Wisdom
Greek.title: Bishop
Greek.text: The patron of strategy raises an impenetrable aegis. She punishes those who attack without a tactical advantage.

Greek.name: Artemis, the Olympus Huntress
Greek.title: Bishop
Greek.text: She stalks her prey from the safety of the wild. Her silver bow strikes targets deep within enemy territory.

Greek.name: Ares, the Olympian's Warlord
Greek.title: Pawn
Greek.text: Driven by an unquenchable thirst for conflict, he amplifies his strength in the heat of melee combat.

Greek.name: Hermes, the Divine Messenger
Greek.title: Knight
Greek.text: Moving faster than the wind, he bypasses frontline defenders to deliver devastating, surgical strikes.

Greek.name: Hephaestus, Forge Master
Greek.title: Pawn
Greek.text: Working tirelessly at his anvil, he crafts celestial armor that permanently empowers his chosen allies.

Greek.name: Aphrodite, Goddess of Love
Greek.title: Pawn
Greek.text: Her beauty bewitches the battlefield. She inspires warriors to fight with a passion that defies reason.

Greek.name: Demeter, Goddess of Harvest
Greek.title: Pawn
Greek.text: The cycle of the seasons answers to her. She breathes life into exhausted forces, preparing them for a second harvest.

Greek.name: Dionysus, God of Joy
Greek.title: Pawn
Greek.text: He intoxicates his foes with maddening revelry. Those who strike him find their minds sealed in a drunken stupor.

Greek.name: Achilles, the Invulnerable
Greek.title: Pawn
Greek.text: Blessed by the River Styx, his skin turns away mortal blades. Only an overwhelming force can break his defense.

Greek.name: Heracles, the First Hero
Greek.title: Pawn
Greek.text: With the strength of a god, his club shatters formations. The shockwaves of his blows cripple adjacent enemies.

Greek.name: Medusa, the Gorgon
Greek.title: Pawn
Greek.text: Her gaze turns flesh to stone. Any attacker foolish enough to cross her path is paralyzed for three turns.

Norse.name: Odin, the All-Father
Norse.title: King
Norse.text: Possessing cosmic wisdom, the All-Father manipulates the very threads of fate. He instantly revives his fallen champions.

Norse.name: Frigg, Queen of Æsir
Norse.title: Queen
Norse.text: The mother of Asgard weaves destiny and cleanses the battlefield. Her magic protects the worthy from lasting harm.

Norse.name: Thor, God of Thunder
Norse.title: Rook
Norse.text: Wielding Mjölnir, his strikes land with earth-shattering force. His raw power easily overwhelms standard defenses.

Norse.name: Loki, the Trickster
Norse.title: Bishop
Norse.text: A master of illusion and deceit. Striking him only triggers a trap, sealing the attacker away for nearly the entire battle.

Norse.name: Heimdall, the Watcher
Norse.title: Bishop
Norse.text: Guarding the Bifrost, his sight extends beyond realms. None may pass his watch without paying a massive toll in power.

Norse.name: Tyr, the One-Handed
Norse.title: Pawn
Norse.text: The god of war sacrificed his hand to bind the wolf. Now, he binds the movement of any who dare attack him.

Norse.name: Njord, God of the Sea
Norse.title: Pawn
Norse.text: Master of ships and storms. He acts as an immovable coastal fortress against invading hordes.

Norse.name: Freyr, Lord of Alfheim
Norse.title: Rook
Norse.text: Riding his golden boar, he blesses his warriors with the vitality of the light elves, permanently boosting their might.

Norse.name: Ullr, the Hunter
Norse.title: Knight
Norse.text: A peerless archer on skis. He navigates the battlefield with ease, picking off unprotected targets.

Norse.name: Skadi, the Winter Bow
Norse.title: Knight
Norse.text: The goddess of winter hunting leaves no tracks. Her arrows bypass the frontline to strike at the heart of the enemy.

Norse.name: Baldur, the Beautiful
Norse.title: Pawn
Norse.text: Loved by all things, almost no weapon can harm him. He stands as a beacon of defense for the Norse.

Norse.name: Fenrir, the Great Wolf
Norse.title: Pawn
Norse.text: The beast destined to devour the sun. His fangs shred through armor, turning low influence into lethal strikes.

Norse.name: Jörmungandr, World Serpent
Norse.title: Pawn
Norse.text: The serpent that encircles Midgard cannot be permanently slain. It constantly regenerates to tie up enemy forces.

Norse.name: Idunn, Keeper of Apples
Norse.title: Pawn
Norse.text: She holds the golden apples of youth. Feeding them to her allies grants them renewed, permanent vigor.

Norse.name: Bragi, God of Poetry
Norse.title: Pawn
Norse.text: His skaldic verses inspire greatness and cleanse the mind. A single song can ready an exhausted warrior.

Norse.name: Valkyrie Commander
Norse.title: Pawn
Norse.text: Choosers of the slain, they command the battlefield even in death. They effortlessly return to Valhalla's ranks.

Egyptian.name: Osiris, Bearer of the Crook & Flail
Egyptian.title: King
Egyptian.text: The King of the Underworld understands that death is merely a resource. He eternally returns from the grave to guide his subjects.

Egyptian.name: Ra, The Iaret's Fury
Egyptian.title: Queen
Egyptian.text: The divine, fire-spitting Uraeus cobra rests on his brow. Its solar flames sweep across the grid, reducing adjacent foes to ash.

Egyptian.name: Sekhmet, The Eye of Bloodlust
Egyptian.title: Rook
Egyptian.text: Born from the eye of Ra to punish humanity. Her unquenchable thirst for destruction brutally amplifies her offensive strikes.

Egyptian.name: Apep, The Serpent of Isfet
Egyptian.title: Rook
Egyptian.text: The embodiment of the chaotic void. It seeks to swallow the sun, lashing out at all nearby forces of order.

Egyptian.name: Isis, Weaver of True Names
Egyptian.title: Bishop
Egyptian.text: A master of Heka. By speaking the true, hidden names of her allies, she instantly commands them to rise from exhaustion.

Egyptian.name: Horus of the Khopesh
Egyptian.title: Bishop
Egyptian.text: Wielding the iconic sickle-sword, the falcon god hooks enemy shields and drives his blade straight through entire columns.

Egyptian.name: Anubis, The Weighing of the Heart
Egyptian.title: Knight
Egyptian.text: He stands at the scales of justice. Attacking him triggers the ritual; those found wanting are cursed and sealed.

Egyptian.name: Thoth, Scribe of the Gods
Egyptian.title: Knight
Egyptian.text: The keeper of cosmic knowledge. His incantations cleanse dark magic and restore balance to the battlefield.

Egyptian.name: Sobek, The Nile's Jaws
Egyptian.title: Pawn
Egyptian.text: The crocodilian lord of the river. His thick scales and fierce territorial nature make him an immovable barricade.

Egyptian.name: Bastet, The Shadow Prowler
Egyptian.title: Pawn
Egyptian.text: A nimble, feline assassin. She strikes from the shadows, easily leaping over frontline defenders to find her mark.

Egyptian.name: Serqet, The Venomous
Egyptian.title: Pawn
Egyptian.text: The scorpion goddess protects the innocent. Her venom paralyzes any enemy foolish enough to strike her.

Egyptian.name: Ma'at, The Feather of Truth
Egyptian.title: Pawn
Egyptian.text: She is the cosmic order that binds the universe. Her presence grants absolute, unwavering strength to her champions.

Egyptian.name: Ptah, The Divine Architect
Egyptian.title: Pawn
Egyptian.text: The creator god of craftsmen. He constructs defensive formations so perfect they are nearly impossible to breach.

Egyptian.name: Khnum, The Potter of Life
Egyptian.title: Pawn
Egyptian.text: He molds human bodies on a potter's wheel. In battle, he simply remolds his exhausted warriors back to a ready state.

Egyptian.name: Hathor, The Sky Cow
Egyptian.title: Pawn
Egyptian.text: The goddess of joy and music. Her divine melodies inspire allied troops, granting them permanent combat superiority.

Egyptian.name: Taweret, The Fierce Mother
Egyptian.title: Pawn
Egyptian.text: A hippopotamus deity fiercely protective of her young. When provoked, her defensive bulk translates into crushing counter-attacks.

Japanese.name: Izanagi, Stirrer of the Oceans
Japanese.title: King
Japanese.text: Wielding the Heavenly Jeweled Spear, he sculpted the islands of Japan. He can literally reshape the battlefield, resurging fallen units.

Japanese.name: Susanoo & The Kusanagi
Japanese.title: Queen
Japanese.text: The chaotic storm god wields the mythical Grass-Cutting Sword. His sweeping strikes devastate multiple enemies at once.

Japanese.name: Juzumaru Tsunetsugu
Japanese.title: Rook
Japanese.text: One of the Five Swords Under Heaven, wrapped in Buddhist prayer beads. Its holy aura wards off all but the strongest evil.

Japanese.name: Onimaru Kunitsuna
Japanese.title: Rook
Japanese.text: A phantom blade so spiritually potent it moves on its own. It pierces straight through demon columns with lethal precision.

Japanese.name: Raijin, The Thunder Strike
Japanese.title: Bishop
Japanese.text: The god of thunder hurls lightning from the heavens. The resulting blast pierces directly through enemy formations.

Japanese.name: Fujin, The Gale Force
Japanese.title: Bishop
Japanese.text: Carrying the winds in his bag, he unleashes typhoons that cut cleanly through any barricades placed before him.

Japanese.name: Ashinagatenaga
Japanese.title: Knight
Japanese.text: A symbiotic Yokai—one with long legs carrying one with long arms. Their bizarre anatomy allows for unexpectedly powerful strikes.

Japanese.name: Kamaitachi
Japanese.title: Knight
Japanese.text: The sickle-weasel Yokai rides the wind. It cuts so fast the victim feels no pain, bypassing blockers to snipe key targets.

Japanese.name: Tsukuyomi, The Moon's Veil
Japanese.title: Pawn
Japanese.text: The god of the moon shrouds the battlefield in darkness. Those who attempt to strike him lose their way and become sealed.

Japanese.name: Orochi, The Eight-Headed
Japanese.title: Pawn
Japanese.text: A legendary, multi-headed serpent that refuses to die. Decapitating one head merely buys time before it strikes again.

Japanese.name: Gashadokuro
Japanese.title: Pawn
Japanese.text: A towering skeleton composed of the unburied dead. Its massive size acts as a brute-force weapon on the front lines.

Japanese.name: Tengu of the High Peaks
Japanese.title: Pawn
Japanese.text: Avian mountain spirits that soar above the grid. They drop from the sky to eliminate targets hiding in the back rows.

Japanese.name: Kitsune Illusionist
Japanese.title: Pawn
Japanese.text: A multi-tailed fox spirit dealing in trickery. Its illusions can make an exhausted samurai believe they are fresh for battle.

Japanese.name: Zashiki-warashi
Japanese.title: Pawn
Japanese.text: A house spirit of fortune. It grants immense luck to its allies, but if it is killed, that fortune turns to ruin.

Japanese.name: Yuki-onna, The Snow Maiden
Japanese.title: Pawn
Japanese.text: She brings the silence of a winter storm. A single touch from an attacker results in them being frozen solid.

Japanese.name: Kappa, The River Child
Japanese.title: Pawn
Japanese.text: A mischievous water spirit. It drowns any enemy attempting to cross its territory unless they possess overwhelming force.
